name: Graveyard conditions do not hold short of their number
notes: The same cards as graveyard-conditions-read-whose-which-and-how-many with too few cards: your graveyard Craw Wurm, Shock, Forest (three card types, three mana values, two permanent cards, no artifact, no sorcery, no Desert); the opponent's 6 lands. Each stays as printed; So Tiny gives -2/-0, Mind Carver +1/+0; The Warring Triad is not a creature (fewer than eight). Crypt Feaster's threshold trigger reads three cards as it is fired, so it fires nothing.
